title: Battle of Arita-Nakaide
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Arita-Nakaide", at revision 1371784243, opens: "The Battle of Arita-Nakaide (有田中井手の戦) took place in 1517 in Aki Province, Japan during the Sengoku period. During the battle, Takeda Motoshige was defeated by a young Mōri Motonari. It was Motonari's first battle." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1010239, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1517 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
